c74object.name: evi.quadosc~
c74object.description: A quadrature oscillator which outputs phase synchronous cosine and sine waves.

inlet.description: The frequency of the oscillators in Hz
Reset the phase of the oscillators. This is a naive reset and will click.

outlet.description: If syncout == 1, a sync signal corresponding the the cosine phase is output here on every cycle
If syncout == 1, a sync signal corresponding the the sine phase is output here on every cycle

objarg.name: frequency
objarg.description: The initial frequency of the oscillators in Hz

objarg.name: syncout
objarg.description: Syncout can only be a typed in argument and is not dynamic.

method.name: int
method.description: The frequency of the oscillators in Hz

method.name: float
method.description: The frequency of the oscillators in Hz

method.name: clear
method.digest: Clears the internal state (like a reset)
method.description: Message rate version of the right reset inlet

method.name: signal
method.description: In left inlet, the frequency of the oscillators in Hz In right inlet, sample accurate reset of the ocillators phase

attribute.name: frequency
attribute.description: The frequency of the oscillators in Hz

attribute.name: syncout
attribute.digest: Syncout mode 0/1 (0 = no sync outlets, the default, 1 = add sync outlets)
attribute.description: syncout can only be a typed in attribute and is not dynamic.
